source(output(
		CID as integer,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	M.CID, 	M.SUBSCRIBER_ID, 	MAX(I.CREATE_DATE) AS CREATE_DATE FROM 	CKOLTP.MEMBER_COVERAGE M WITH (NOLOCK) 	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_PATIENT P WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.CID = P.CID 	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_NOTEPAD N WITH (NOLOCK) ON P.ID = N.PATIENT_ID 	INNER JOIN CKOLTP.ORG_INFO I WITH (NOLOCK) ON N.INFO_ID = I.ID WHERE 	I.TEMPLATE_ID = 500905 	AND I.CREATE_DATE > CONVERT(DATETIME, ?, 101) GROUP BY 	M.CID, 	M.SUBSCRIBER_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetCompletedMMPContactNotesFromCAEOLTPUTIL	source(output(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp,
		CALL_PHONE_NUMBER as string,
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		CALL_DATE as string,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT 	SUBSTRING(M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER, 1, 9) AS SUBSCRIBER_ID, 	PC.CALL_CREATE_DT AS CREATE_DATE, 	PC.CALL_PHONENUMBER AS CALL_PHONE_NUMBER, 	CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PC.CALL_CALLDATETIME, 101) AS CALL_DATE, 	CL.CALLLIST_CD, 	PC.CALL_CALLDATETIME FROM 	PDS_CALL PC WITH (NOLOCK) 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DIS WITH (NOLOCK) ON DIS.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = PC.CALL_DISPOSITIONCODE_IID  	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CLIST WITH (NOLOCK) ON CLIST.CALLLISTMASTER_IID = PC.CALL_CALLLISTMASTER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M WITH (NOLOCK) ON M.MEMBER_IID = CLIST.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CLD WITH (NOLOCK) ON CLD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CLIST.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLIST CL WITH (NOLOCK) ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CLD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID WHERE 	M.MEMBER_MCAID_PRODUCT_CD = \'MMP\' 	AND DIS.DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE <> \'AGENT\' 	AND PC.CALL_CALLDATETIME > CONVERT(DATETIME, ?, 101) 	AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'358\',\'359\') ORDER BY SUBSCRIBER_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetContactInfoFromPDS2008	source(output(
		CALLLIST_CD as string,
		SOURCE as integer,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		USER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		TEXT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SET NOCOUNT ON  DECLARE @TABLE_VAR TABLE (   CALLLIST_CD VARCHAR(10),    [SOURCE] INT,   FORM_ID INT,   CONCEPT_ID INT,   CONCEPT_VALUE VARCHAR(150),   [USER_ID] INT,   TRANSFER_STATUS VARCHAR(1),   [TEXT] VARCHAR(1) )  INSERT INTO @TABLE_VAR (CALLLIST_CD, [SOURCE], FORM_ID, CONCEPT_ID, CONCEPT_VALUE, [USER_ID], TRANSFER_STATUS, [TEXT]) VALUES (358, 65, 500905, 543438, NULL, 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 543439, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 543440, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 543442, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 543443, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 543469, \'Unsuccessful Initial Assessment Attempt. Member contacted by dialer at XXX-XXX-XXXX. Contact unsuccessful.\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 546984, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 564938, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 564941, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 564942, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 564943, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (358, 65, 500905, 543444, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL),  (359, 65, 500905, 543438, NULL, 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543439, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543440, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543442, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543443, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543459, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543460, NULL, 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543462, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543469, \'Unsuccessful Reassessment Attempt. Member contacted by dialer at XXX-XXX-XXXX. Contact unsuccessful.\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 546984, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 564938, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 564941, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 564942, \'1\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 564943, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL), (359, 65, 500905, 543444, \'2\', 2597, \'P\', NULL)  SELECT * FROM @TABLE_VAR',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> TableVariableforConceptValues	source(output(
		CID as integer,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CID, CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), SUBSCRIBER_ID) AS SUBSCRIBER_ID FROM CKOLTP.MEMBER_COVERAGE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTILLKPTABLE
GetCompletedMMPContactNotesFromCAEOLTPUTIL sort(asc(CID, false)) ~> Sort1
TableVariableforConceptValues sort(asc(CALLLIST_CD, false)) ~> Sort2
GetContactInfoFromPDS2008,LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTILLKPTABLE lookup(GetContactInfoFromPDS2008@SUBSCRIBER_ID == LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTILLKPTABLE@SUBSCRIBER_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTIL
LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTIL select(mapColumn(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = GetContactInfoFromPDS2008@SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_PHONE_NUMBER = CALL_PHONE_NUMBER,
		CALLLIST_CD = CALLLIST_CD,
		CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME = CALL_CALLDATETIME,
		CID = CID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTILSelect
LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTILSelect filter(isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTIL
FilterLookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTIL sort(asc(CID, false)) ~> Sort3
Sort3,Sort1 join(LookupCIDsFromCAEOLTPUTILSelect@CID == GetCompletedMMPContactNotesFromCAEOLTPUTIL@CID,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LeftOuterJoin
LeftOuterJoin select(mapColumn(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = GetCompletedMMPContactNotesFromCAEOLTPUTIL@SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		CREATE_DATE = GetCompletedMMPContactNotesFromCAEOLTPUTIL@CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_PHONE_NUMBER = CALL_PHONE_NUMBER,
		CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE,
		CALLLIST_CD = CALLLIST_CD,
		CID = GetCompletedMMPContactNotesFromCAEOLTPUTIL@CID,
		FORM_CREATE_DATE = FORM_CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME = CALL_CALLDATETIME
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LeftOuterJoinSelect
LeftOuterJoinSelect derive(SUBSCRIBER_ID = SUBSCRIBER_ID,
		CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_PHONE_NUMBER = CALL_PHONE_NUMBER,
		CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE,
		CALLLIST_CD = CALLLIST_CD,
		CID = CID,
		FORM_CREATE_DATE = FORM_CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME = CALL_CALLDATETIME) ~> LeftOuterJoinREFORMAT1
LeftOuterJoinREFORMAT1 split(isNull(FORM_CREATE_DATE),greaterOrEqual(FORM_CREATE_DATE,CALL_CALLDATETIME),FORM_CREATE_DATE < CALL_CALLDATETIME, disjoint: true) ~> FindRecordstoKeep@(Keep2,Nope,Keep,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
FindRecordstoKeep@Keep2,FindRecordstoKeep@Keep union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll
UnionAll sort(asc(CALLLIST_CD, false)) ~> Sort
Sort,Sort2 join(UnionAll@CALLLIST_CD == TableVariableforConceptValues@CALLLIST_CD,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> InnerJoin2
InnerJoin2 select(mapColumn(
		CALL_PHONE_NUMBER = CALL_PHONE_NUMBER,
		CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE,
		CALLLIST_CD = TableVariableforConceptValues@CALLLIST_CD,
		CID = CID,
		SOURCE = SOURCE,
		FORM_ID = FORM_ID,
		CONCEPT_ID = CONCEPT_ID,
		USER_ID = USER_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS = TRANSFER_STATUS,
		TEXT = TEXT,
		CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME = CALL_CALLDATETIME,
		CONCEPT_VALUE = CONCEPT_VALUE
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> InnerJoin2Select
InnerJoin2Select derive(CALL_PHONE_NUMBER = CALL_PHONE_NUMBER,
		CALL_DATE = CALL_DATE,
		CALLLIST_CD = CALLLIST_CD,
		CID = CID,
		SOURCE = SOURCE,
		FORM_ID = FORM_ID,
		CONCEPT_ID = CONCEPT_ID,
		USER_ID = USER_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS = TRANSFER_STATUS,
		TEXT = TEXT,
		CREATE_DATE = CREATE_DATE,
		CALL_CALLDATETIME = CALL_CALLDATETIME,
		CONCEPT_VALUE = CONCEPT_VALUE) ~> InnerJoin2REFORMAT1
InnerJoin2REFORMAT1 derive(CONCEPT_VALUE = iif(CONCEPT_ID == 543438, toString(CALL_DATE), (iif(CONCEPT_ID == 543460, toString(CALL_DATE), (iif(CONCEPT_ID == 543469, replace(CONCEPT_VALUE, toString('XXX-XXX-XXXX'), toString(CALL_PHONE_NUMBER)), CONCEPT_VALUE)))))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		UPDATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SOURCE as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		TEXT as string,
		CONCEPT_VALUE as string,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_ID,
		UPDATE_DATE = CALL_CALLDATETIME,
		SOURCE,
		USER_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS,
		TEXT,
		CONCEPT_VALUE,
		FORM_ID,
		CID)) ~> InsertRecordsintoCPMWBFORMCAREPLUSMOBILE

	format: 'query',

		GRGR_ID_STR = GRGR_ID,
		PRAD_STATE_STR = PRAD_STATE,
		SBAD_ADDR1_STR = SBAD_ADDR1,
		SBAD_PHONE_STR = SBAD_PHONE,

		MEPE_TERM_DT_STR = MEPE_TERM_DT,
		PRAD_ZIP_STR = PRAD_ZIP,
